caseName: Ford Motor Co. v. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: Ford Motor Co. v. National Labor Relations Board
attorneys: Messrs. Frederick H. Wood and Alfred McCormack for petitioner. Solicitor General Biddle and Messrs. Warner W. Gardner, Robert B. Watts, Laurence A. Knapp, and Mortimer B. Wolf for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
